id: 12_Replace the AC Power Supply Board for xTool MetalFab Laser Welder
title: 激光焊接机交流电源板的规范更换
source_doc: course/Cleanroom & Equipment Safety/12_Replace the AC Power Supply Board for xTool MetalFab Laser Welder.md
author_source: project/Cleanroom & Equipment Safety/12_Replace the AC Power Supply Board for xTool MetalFab Laser Welder/src.py

points.S6: 电气起火：先断电，不用水

shots.scene: 欣欣站在激光焊接机旁，身后墙上是一个插座和配电箱，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a gray wheeled laser welding machine, with a wall socket and a small distribution box behind it, and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课，看焊机的交流电源板怎样更换。
overlay: 激光焊接机交流电源板的规范更换

shots.scene: 电网输电线、插头、电路板、焊机四个图标用箭头连起
shots.prompt_en: Four icons joined by arrows: a power line tower, a plug, a circuit board and a laser welding machine. No people.
shots.narration: 市电进机器，第一站就是这块板。

shots.scene: 阿杰把焊机插头插在一个已经插满电器的多孔插线板上
shots.prompt_en: The young male student plugs the laser welding machine into a crowded power strip already full of other plugs.
shots.narration: 阿杰把焊机插在一个插满的插线板上。

shots.scene: 插线板冒出一缕烟，焊机屏幕黑了
shots.prompt_en: A thin wisp of smoke rises from the overloaded power strip and the machine's screen goes dark.
shots.narration: 一开焊，插线板冒烟，焊机也不亮了。

shots.scene: 小研立刻拉下墙上的开关，老李赶来检查
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student quickly switches off the wall breaker, and the facility engineer arrives to inspect.
shots.narration: 小研先断电，老李检查后要换电源板。

shots.section_title: 电气起火：先断电，不用水
shots.scene: 欣欣举起手掌，旁边配电箱开关被拉下
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot raises a paw beside a distribution box whose breaker has been switched off.
shots.narration: 电器冒烟起火，第一步是断电。
overlay: 电气起火：先断电，不用水

shots.section_title: 电气起火：先断电，不用水
shots.scene: 二氧化碳灭火器和干粉灭火器打勾，水桶泼向电器打叉
shots.prompt_en: Two icons with green check marks: a carbon dioxide fire extinguisher and a dry powder extinguisher; a bucket of water thrown at an electrical device is crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 用适用的灭火器，不能泼水。

shots.section_title: 电气起火：先断电，不用水
shots.scene: 小研打电话，旁边报告图标和数字119
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student makes a phone call beside a report icon and the number 119.
shots.narration: 火控制不住打119，并报告负责人。

shots.scene: 焊机插在墙上的专用插座，旁边空白标签
shots.prompt_en: The laser welding machine plugged alone into a dedicated wall socket with a blank label beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 大功率焊机，要接容量够的专用插座。

shots.scene: 多孔插线板串着插线板的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of power strips plugged into each other in a chain, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不用插线板，更不能串接、私拉电线。

shots.scene: 欣欣举着黄黑边框警示卡，卡面只有闪电和人形打叉图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a warning card with a yellow and black striped border, showing a lightning bolt icon and a crossed-out person icon.
shots.narration: 换电源板只限专业人员动手。

shots.scene: 老李把焊机电源开关拨到关
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer switches the main power switch of the laser welding machine to off.
shots.narration: 先关机、断电。

shots.scene: 机箱剖面示意：一边闪电图标，一边激光束图标
shots.prompt_en: A simple cutaway diagram of a machine cabinet with a lightning bolt icon on one side and a red laser beam icon on the other side. No people.
shots.narration: 机内高压和强激光，会触电、烧伤。

shots.scene: 拔掉插头的焊机内部，一个模块上闪电图标，旁边沙漏
shots.prompt_en: Inside an unplugged machine cabinet, one module shows a glowing lightning bolt icon, with an hourglass beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 断电后仍有残余高压，要等待。

shots.scene: 老李戴上厚绝缘手套
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer pulls on thick insulated gloves.
shots.narration: 全程戴好绝缘手套。

shots.scene: 工作台上摆着大小两把十字螺丝刀和一块新的黑色电源板
shots.prompt_en: On a workbench lie two cross-head screwdrivers of different sizes and a new blank black power supply circuit board. No people.
shots.narration: 备好大小两把十字刀和新电源板。

shots.scene: 焊机背面接口全部空着，电源线放在一边
shots.prompt_en: The back of the laser welding machine with all sockets empty; the unplugged power cable lies coiled on the floor. No people.
shots.narration: 确认所有连接都已断开。

shots.scene: 老李踩下脚轮刹车
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer presses down the brake on a caster wheel with his foot.
shots.narration: 四个脚轮全部锁住。

shots.scene: 焊机静静放着，墙上时钟指针转动
shots.prompt_en: The closed laser welding machine stands still while a wall clock shows time passing. No people.
shots.narration: 按说明书规定静置，放电、冷却。

shots.scene: 老李打开焊机左侧门板
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer opens the hinged left side door of the laser welding machine.
shots.narration: 打开左侧门板。

shots.scene: 老李用十字刀拆送丝安装板周边螺钉，零件盒里螺钉渐多
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer removes the screws around the wire feeder mounting plate; a parts tray beside him fills with screws.
shots.narration: 拆下安装板周边十四颗螺钉。

shots.scene: 老李用小十字刀拆黄绿色接地线的螺钉
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer uses a small cross-head screwdriver to remove the screw of the yellow-green earth wire.
shots.narration: 再拆下接地线的螺钉。

shots.scene: 安装板放平，露出机内电气区
shots.prompt_en: The mounting plate is laid outward, revealing neat wiring and blank modules inside the cabinet.
shots.narration: 放平安装板，露出电气区。

shots.scene: 机内一块黑色电路板，上面印着黄色三角闪电标志，旁边一个白色滤波器盒
shots.prompt_en: Inside the cabinet, a black circuit board printed with a yellow triangle lightning warning symbol, next to a small white filter box. No people.
shots.narration: 这就是交流电源板，接的是市电。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着放大的当心触电警告标志
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at a large electric shock warning sign.
shots.narration: 看到这个标志，就是当心触电。

shots.scene: 欣欣摇手，手指靠近标志区域的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves a paw; an icon of a finger reaching toward the marked area is crossed out with a red X.
shots.narration: 没确认无电，标志附近一律不碰。

shots.scene: 小研给电源板接线拍照，老李逐个拧下端子螺丝
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student photographs the board wiring while the facility engineer unscrews the terminals one by one.
shots.narration: 拍照留底后，拆下板上各根导线。

shots.scene: 老李拔下电源板上的直流电源线插头
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer unplugs the DC power cable connector from the board.
shots.narration: 拔下直流电源线。

shots.scene: 老李拆下电路板四个角的螺钉
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer removes the four corner screws of the circuit board.
shots.narration: 拆下四个角的螺钉。

shots.scene: 旧电源板被取出
shots.prompt_en: The old power supply board is lifted out of the cabinet.
shots.narration: 取下旧电源板。

shots.scene: 新电源板放进原位，四颗螺钉拧紧
shots.prompt_en: The new power supply board is placed in position and its four corner screws are tightened.
shots.narration: 新板放回原位，四颗螺钉固定。

shots.scene: 画面一角是接线参考图，老李逐根把导线接回端子
shots.prompt_en: A small reference wiring picture in the corner while the facility engineer reconnects each wire to the board terminals.
shots.narration: 对照参考图，一根一根接回导线。

shots.scene: 参考图和实物端子用虚线一一对应
shots.prompt_en: Split view: a blank reference wiring picture and the real terminals, with matching dotted lines between them. No people.
shots.narration: 位置、颜色都要和参考图一致。

shots.scene: 环形端子拧紧在螺钉下，铜丝全部包在端子里
shots.prompt_en: Close view of a ring terminal tightened under a screw, with all copper strands neatly inside the terminal. No people.
shots.narration: 端子要拧紧，铜丝不能露在外面。

shots.scene: 端子压着绝缘皮、铜丝外露分叉两个图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: a terminal clamped on insulation and a terminal with frayed copper strands sticking out, both crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 压住绝缘皮、铜丝分叉，都会发热。

shots.scene: 老李逐根轻拉导线
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer gently tugs each wire at the terminals.
shots.narration: 接完逐根轻拉，确认不松。

shots.scene: 一根黄绿双色线特写，旁边接地符号
shots.prompt_en: Close view of a yellow-green striped wire next to an earth symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 黄绿双色线，是保护接地线。

shots.scene: 黄绿线接到别的端子的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a yellow-green wire connected to a wrong terminal, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 只能接在接地端，不能挪作他用。

shots.scene: 直流电源线插回电源板
shots.prompt_en: The DC power cable connector is plugged back into the new board.
shots.narration: 插回直流电源线。

shots.scene: 老李抬回安装板，插回送丝电机线
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer lifts the mounting plate back and plugs the wire feeder motor cable into the main board.
shots.narration: 抬回安装板，接回送丝电机线。

shots.scene: 接地线螺钉拧紧，周边螺钉装回，关上门板
shots.prompt_en: The earth wire screw is tightened, the screws around the plate are refitted and the side door is closed.
shots.narration: 装回接地线和螺钉，关好门板。

shots.scene: 墙上插座回路的漏电保护器，手指按下试验按钮，开关跳开
shots.prompt_en: A finger presses the test button on a residual current circuit breaker for the socket circuit, and the breaker trips off.
shots.narration: 插座回路要有漏电保护器。

shots.scene: 日历图标和试验按钮图标并排
shots.prompt_en: A calendar icon next to a test button icon. No people.
shots.narration: 按规定定期按试验键，能跳才算好。

shots.scene: 漏电保护器不跳闸，旁边空白停用牌
shots.prompt_en: A breaker that does not trip when tested, with a blank out-of-service tag hanging on it. No people.
shots.narration: 按了不跳，停用并报修。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在焊机旁，身后浮现四个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside the laser welding machine with four icons behind: an electric shock warning sign, a ring terminal, a yellow-green wire and a test button.
shots.narration: 认得触电标志，端子接牢，接地不挪。

shots.scene: 欣欣伸出手指数着
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot counts on its fingers.
shots.narration: 专用插座，漏保常试，起火先断电。

shots.scene: 欣欣、老李、小研和阿杰在焊机前挥手，焊机插在专用插座上
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot, the facility engineer, the female graduate student and the young male student wave goodbye beside the machine plugged into its dedicated socket.
shots.narration: 电从哪里来，安全就从哪里管。下次见！
